newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BCP sells shopping centre stake to ING.
newsitem.headline: BCP sells shopping centre stake to ING.

text.p: Portuguese bank Banco Comercial Portugues/Banco Portugues do Atlantico said it had sold its 50 percent stake in Colombo SA, expected to be one of the biggest shopping centres in Europe, to a unit of Dutch banking group ING.

A statement did not reveal the terms of the deal with ING Real Estate. The other 50 percent stake in Colombo, which is located in the Benfica district of Lisbon and is due to open next September, is held by Sonae Imobiliaria, a unit of Portuguese retailer Sonae Investimentos.

"I am pleased that it has been possible to agree on terms so quickly with ING Real Estate, who will make a strong contribution with Sonae to the success of this enterprise," said BCP/BPA chairman Jorge Jardim Goncalves.
On March 22, Alvaro Portela, president of Sonae Imobiliaria, said the total cost of the Colombo project was expected to be 50 billion escudos.
